'''Rouge Bantha Rouge Squadron 0.3''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Rouge Bantha]]
* '''Published:''' 21 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hidden Base
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 HB Bantha LS 2003 RougeSqu.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Hey guys i fixed my deck, thanks for the tips!

The published list has 58 cards.

== Strategy ==

Turn 1: activate 3+ force play one [or more] x-wings one at aquaris the other at hidden base. Turn 2-4: activate  8+ force deploy as much x-wings to each system as possible. turn 6+: activate 14+ force, you should have played haven, put Home one in least likely attacked area. Repeat this, you should only go up to turn eight. You'll win or lose
